lighthouse.scope: Mobile simulated-throttling initial page load; lazy model loading excluded. Not inference performance.

unit_test_names: HTML/SVG and remote URLs cannot enter the photo persistence path
build excludes all benchmark/industrial paths and non-allowlisted images
cannot close action without after photo or wrong owner role
contracts reject missing source, unknown fields and invalid role
dark capture gives RETAKE and no invented score
encoded inspection photos are decoded without a data-URL fetch blocked by CSP
every seeded record conforms to its versioned contract and field provenance
full NCR lifecycle requires completed CAPA and linked closed after-photo action
inspector can submit but cannot disposition; original and audit remain immutable
local upload thumbnails are local blobs; remote traffic stays rejected
only ANOMALY can create a detector NCR and its score is preserved
p99 calibration is frozen before test and cannot learn from test
page and README credit established methods and generated examples
rule suggestions retain provenance and due defaults; ASR is unconfirmed
seeded dashboard aggregates actual local rows and CSV neutralises formula cells
submit rejects unconfirmed inference, missing human quantities and invalid defect code
threshold equality is anomaly; missing bank is error
face_check_scope: Synthetic face redaction with injected box; real model startup check is separate, not face-detection accuracy
recovery: Only failed Inspect handoff rerun for first variant; prior passed Walk/NCR checks retained with source. Other variants run first time.
prototype_limits: No real phone camera, voice or glasses run
Fictional plants and seeded demo data; no pilots or users
Local role checks are not authentication
50+ network size is owner-reported potential reach
